desc:
🚀 Launch. Boost. Dodge. Try again.

Take control of a missile and thread it through tight openings, twisting tunnels, and obstacle-filled maps. Aim your launcher, build momentum with unlimited boost, and use abilities like Grapple, Life Jacket, and Overdrive to pull off risky flights.

Race the clock in Time Trials, complete all five maps in one continuous Circuit run, practise freely in Freeplay, or push your distance in Sim Tube. Upgrade your missiles, customise your loadout, and climb the leaderboards.

Every crash sends you back to the launcher. How clean can you make your next run?
